selected_evidence.summary: Shows node1/node2/node3 at 10.100.143.10, .11, and .12 on the common storage subnet.
Confirms matching passwd and group records on all nodes.
Shows the active /srv/nfs/shared export restricted to both client IPs and directory ownership 4200:4200 with mode 2770.

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent NFSv4 mounts on node2 and node3
selected_evidence.summary: Shows fstab entries and active NFSv4.2 mounts at /mnt/shared.

selected_evidence.requirement: Immediate bidirectional visibility with preserved ownership and permissions
selected_evidence.summary: node3 immediately read node2's file and node2 read and updated node3's file; metadata remained sharedops:sharedops with modes 0660 and 0750.
Captures healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered mount, identity, files, ownership, and permissions.
Captures healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered mount, identity, files, ownership, and permissions.
Captures healthy server baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered NFS service, listener, exports, directory, and data.

selected_evidence.summary: After all restarts, node2 created a new mode-0640 file as sharedops and node3 immediately read it with UID/GID 4200 intact.
